NOT COVERED. (1) The hardware backend was never exercised. The fake is a deterministic in-memory 288-point stand-in (the device's N_PIXELS at pycss45.py:31), not a recording; its state values and synthetic spectrum are test data marked '# placeholder' in fake.py. (2) The declared 360-830 nm range comes from README.md:102 (borders verified on a live CSS45), not from a per-unit calibration. The driver reads the actual per-pixel grid from the device at runtime through get_wl_borders() (_wl_mapping) and filters the measured native grid, so it never invents a wavelength scale. (3) cap.measure.spectrum.v1 publishes the intensities field with unit 1, while the upstream spectrum is calibrated in W m^-2 nm^-1 (pycss45.py:138); the values are returned unchanged and the action description states the discrepancy. (4) PAR has no unit in any text file of the clone, so the read declares none. (5) The temperature is documented as deg C but the upstream docstring says the unit is unverified (pycss45.py:779-780). (6) The action uses the device's automatic integration time (CSS45.measure); the catalogue class's optional integration_ms input is not exposed, and fixed integration times (measure_manual) are not exposed either. (7) No catalogue class binds the temperature read to an instrument.spectrometer resource, so the temperature is a state read rather than cap.measure.temperature.v1. (8) The device is observational (R0, data only): the package declares no native e-stop and no safe-state action, and the receipt reports the runtime software latch only. (9) The upstream demo simulator DemoCSS45 is not used because the card's mock_strategy.preferred is fake; the package fake implements only public methods of pycss45:CSS45.
